items.question: whats the processor called in a normal mega65
items.answer: the mega65 cpu is the 45gs02.

items.question: whats the graphics controller called in a normal mega65
items.answer: the mega65 uses the vic-iv video controller for graphics.

items.question: whats the nominal fastest mega65 clock measured in megahertz
items.answer: the standard full-speed clock is 40.5 mhz; slower compatibility modes are available.

items.question: whats the normal mega65 ram capacity including both kinds
items.answer: standard mega65 boards have 384 kb of chip ram plus 8 mb of attic ram.

items.question: whats the normal mega65 chip ram capacity on its own
items.answer: standard mega65 models have 384 kb of chip ram.

items.question: whats the normal mega65 attic ram capacity on its own
items.answer: standard mega65 boards have 8 mb of attic ram.

items.question: how many kilobytes can the cpu see at once in its direct window
items.answer: the cpu directly sees a 64 kb window; memory mapping selects what appears there.

items.question: how many megabytes of addresses are in the complete 28 bit space
items.answer: the mega65 has a 28-bit address space: 256 mb of addresses.

items.question: what numeric address is the beginning of the attic region
items.answer: attic ram starts at $8000000.

items.question: does the vic iv fetch pixels directly from attic ram
items.answer: no. vic-iv cannot directly read attic ram; copy graphics into chip ram.

items.question: walk through loading a basic program file from a mounted disk

items.question: walk through loading a basic prg file directly from an sd directory

items.question: how do image selection program loading and basic execution fit together
